value.rationale: Worst-case Hilbert--Schmidt lifted intensity gain is a natural stable-reconstruction metric. Optimizing actual bin placement gives an exact two-regime law, identifies amplitude-balance versus interference-visibility bottlenecks, provides sharp small- and large-separation behavior, and supplies a natural minimal-two-bin identifiability boundary. Distinct from standard injectivity and arbitrary unmotivated finite enumeration.
